items.label: Adjustable Strap For Both Sides
items.value: Our Medium Size (7.5*3.5*14.5inch) crossbody bags have one D-ring on each side of the bottom, and a detachable shoulder strap buckle. You can attach the strap for easy access on your left or right shoulder, reducing the strain of carrying your bag for a long time. The strap can be extended up to 34 inches to accommodate different body sizes and you can adjust the length to your comfort.

items.label: Well Organized- Multi-pockets
items.value: You don’t have to waste time searching for things in a cluttered bag! We have 2 front zipper pockets and a buckle pocket that can fit your wallet, and tissue. The main pocket has enough space to fit all the essentials you need, it has 4 open pockets can easily store your tablet, cosmetics, or other essentials. Side mesh pocket can store anything you need for easy access. A special hook for hanging your keys! Have everything you need within reach!

items.label: Durable & Waterproof Material
items.value: Our chest bag are built to last with thick, durable, and abrasion-resistant fabric. The material is also waterproof and tear-resistant, whether you’re hiking through rough terrain or commuting in the rain, our backpacks will keep up with you, ensuring that your belongings stay safe and dry. The backpacks are designed to be lightweight and comfortable, making them perfect for long hikes or daily commutes.

items.label: Comfortable and Safty
items.value: Designed with a soft, breathable mesh back panel which is especially important for people who are carrying heavy loads or hiking in hot and humid weather, it not only provides a comfortable carrying experience, but also isolates the items inside the bag from the skin, prevent discomfort caused by friction. The shoulder straps are designed with reflective strips to ensure you are more visible, so enjoy the fun of outdoor exploration without any worries.

items.label: Practical And Pleasing
items.value: Are you looking for a classic and versatile cross body bag that never goes out of style? Pritent crossbody bags are an ideal product that combines fashion, convenience, and performance. The perfect stylish appearance easy to match various styles of outfits.And there is a hidden headphone hole on the front that provides easy access to your headphones, without the hassle of tangled cords. It’s a great way to stay connected to your favorite tunes while on the go!
